subject: Biotechnology
title: Tumor Mutational Burden
description: Learn Tumor Mutational Burden in one minute.

hook.text: More mutations mean more targets for the immune system — tumor mutational burden predicts immunotherapy response.

buildup.text: TMB counts mutations per megabase of DNA — high-TMB tumors create many neoantigens that T cells can recognize.

discovery.text: The FDA approved pembrolizumab for any high-TMB solid tumor — treatment based on genetics, not cancer type.

twist.text: TMB is not a perfect predictor — some high-TMB tumors do not respond, and some low-TMB tumors do.

climax.text: Combining TMB with PD-L1 expression and immune cell infiltration improves prediction — multi-biomarker panels emerge.

punchline.text: Count the mutations, predict the response — TMB guides immunotherapy decisions.

quiz.question: Why do high-TMB tumors respond better to immunotherapy?
options: High-TMB tumors grow more slowly, giving the immune system more time
More mutations create more neoantigens that immune cells can recognize and target
High-TMB tumors lack the ability to suppress immune responses
